notes: Typewritten soutenance notice from the Université des Sciences et Techniques du Languedoc, Service de la Scolarité; distribution Liste A; notice number 2418.
Dateline: MONTPELLIER, le 19 AVRIL 1977. The two underlined title lines announce a doctorate of speciality in SCIENCES DE LA TERRE, mention GEOLOGIE APPLIQUEE.
Candidate BAYER Michel; thesis title: Etude gravimétrique de la Corse. The notice gives the planned defence as 25 AVRIL 1977 à 14 h. 30, Salle de cours n° 10 - U.S.T.L.
M. LOUIS Pierre is named as thesis director; the preparing laboratory is Laboratoire de Géophysique.

The abstract states that 270 measurements completed the gravimetric survey of Corsica and that the full data set comprised 720 stations. It describes maps of the Bouguer anomaly, derivatives, regional and residual fields, interpreted with geology and aeromagnetism.
The abstract explicitly says: Des hypothèses sont proposées. The proposed hypotheses concern the deep structure of Corsica and neighbouring regions, including the bassin Algéro-provençal.
The duration is Deux ans. The proposed jury consists of P. LOUIS, M. MATTAUER, R. NEUMANN, F. RIMBERT, and J. ORSINI, with the titles and initials retained as typed.
The closing office is Le Secrétaire Général; the underlined typed name is E. SIAU. A faint autograph and long returning flourish lie between office and typed name.
The lower-left handwritten 3 is the archive sheet number, retained only as a TeX comment.
